summary: Bind current package, startup and Library probes to full MIR 4.3 source identities.
details: Admit explicit 4.3.0 and 4.3.1 destinations in current metadata, startup and Library probe callers while preserving historical defaults. Validate source minor and patch together so cross-minor identities cannot be relabelled.
Preserve exact throwing resource snapshots in admission and interrupted-process receipts without changing memory, commit, disk or process cleanup thresholds.

Controlled startup and native-probe actor tests cover 4.3 propagation, wrong-minor rejection, README identity and existing resource recovery. They run no Factorio and establish no final release qualification.
